senses.definition_en: An extremely strong feeling of dislike, hostility, or ill will.
senses.definition_ar: شعور قوي للغاية بالكره أو العداوة أو البغضاء.
examples: She felt no hatred towards her ex-husband.
The war was fueled by racial hatred.
His speech incited hatred against the minority group.

candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hate' 'يكره'.. الـ 'Hatred' هو الاسم منها، الكراهية العميقة.
